researchScope: Eight existing owner-selected US-English worksheet topics checked against named public competitor page content. The page observations were obtained via public web search, NOT a location-locked Google US SERP rank export.
limitations: Do not infer Google positions, keyword difficulty changes, traffic, rich-result eligibility, or feature popularity from these observations. Competitor descriptions are based on public page text. Do not automatically allowlist any page for indexation.

observations.observed: Competitor customizes one-step equations by integers, decimals and fractions, with an optional answer sheet.
observations.ourFeature: Solving one-step integer addition and multiplication equations with positive/negative coefficients and a matching answer PDF.
observations.gap: Decimal/fraction equations are not implemented. Avoid implying all-number-types coverage.

observations.observed: Competitor offers different two-step equation PDFs for integers, decimals, fractions, word problems and equation verification.
observations.ourFeature: Integer-coefficient two-step equations with variable coefficient sign choices, matching answer and verified worked steps.
observations.gap: Decimals, fractional coefficients and word-story problem variants are missing. State integer scope explicitly.

observations.observed: Competitor has separate difficulty and grade families including parentheses, exponent and nested-parentheses examples.
observations.ourFeature: Generated 3-operation-style expressions using a selectable grouping and operation focus, including some exponents.
observations.gap: Do not claim a nested-parentheses, grade-certified or curriculum-aligned variant without separate testing.

observations.observed: Competitor offers fixed missing-numerator/denominator equivalent-fraction worksheets and separate repeated PDF sets.
observations.ourFeature: Matching missing numerator or denominator in proper equivalent fractions with reproducible problem sets and answer keys.
observations.gap: No illustrated fractions or grade certification; primary practice intent overlaps existing task, but Google SERP competitiveness is not measured.

observations.observed: Competitor spans integer, decimal, fraction, conversions, many shape variants, and missing-base/height exercises.
observations.ourFeature: Base × perpendicular height / 2 and missing-height calculation with simple numeric geometry diagrams and units.
observations.gap: Unit conversions, fractional measurement, Heron's formula and equilateral-specialist cases are missing. Avoid claiming broad family coverage.

observations.observed: Competitor worksheet pack includes volume formula, unit cubes, joined composite rectangular prisms, missing edge and story problems.
observations.ourFeature: Single rectangular-prism volume or missing height from supplied integer dimensions, with printable diagram and matching answers.
observations.gap: Composite rectangular prisms, layered unit-cube counting and word problems are not currently generated.

observations.observed: Competitor makes a 1-12 multiplication table reference with and without answers, as distinct from timed or randomized multiplication drills.
observations.ourFeature: Previously only random 1–12 multiplication fact drills; R64 adds a true 13×13 labelled multiplication grid with all 144 blank student body cells and a separately filled answer chart.
observations.gap: Static reference chart intent now has an exact matching feature; printed 1–12 matrix still lacks modes for 0–12, arbitrary 100-grid or timed tests.

observations.observed: Competitor offers printable 180° and 360° instruments with A4/Letter PDFs and ruler scale checks.
observations.ourFeature: Calibrated vector 180° protractor PDF on Letter/A4, precise 72 mm radius with 50 mm ruler reference.
observations.gap: 360° type and variable diameter are not implemented; physical print accuracy is not measured by CI.
